SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) m, count(*) v,
 count(DISTINCT (member_id, join_date)) mj,
 count(DISTINCT member_key) mk,
 sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur
FROM dim_member WHERE join_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND join_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'

SELECT nh, nv, count(*), sum(CASE WHEN mvf = join_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) first_ver_at_join FROM j WHERE year(join_date)=2025 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH first AS (
 SELECT member_id, join_date, arg_min(home_store_id, valid_from) store_at_join, arg_max(home_store_id, valid_from) store_now
 FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT f.store_at_join, (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT store_name, ' / ') FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=f.store_at_join) nm,
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(close_date AS VARCHAR), ',') FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=f.store_at_join) cl,
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT CAST(open_date AS VARCHAR), ',') FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=f.store_at_join) op,
 count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN store_now<>store_at_join THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) moved
FROM first f WHERE year(join_date)=2025 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH signups AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, arg_min(home_store_id, valid_from) AS signup_store_id
  FROM dim_member
  WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY member_id, join_date),
names AS (SELECT store_id, arg_max(store_name, valid_from) AS store_name FROM dim_store GROUP BY store_id)
SELECT s.signup_store_id AS store_id, n.store_name, count(*) AS new_members
FROM signups s LEFT JOIN names n ON n.store_id = s.signup_store_id
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
